args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Incident opened to track investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and the v2.3.1 regression.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
